title: Christophe Pettus - PostgreSQL Proficiency for Python People - PyCon 2016
summary: A three-hour PyCon 2016 tutorial by Christophe Pettus that orients Python developers to PostgreSQL. It covers installation, administration, and use, including vacuuming, MVCC, replication and backups.
why: HN readers recommend it as a thorough, practical introduction to Postgres fundamentals and optimization for application developers.

quote.text: I found this to be great introductory that touches on all the major points to keep in mind with Postgres.
